title: Coricancha andesite stonework

tellings.quote: the most the most impressive stonework in all of the ancient world.

plain: The andesite stonework of Coricancha, an ancient site in Cusco, Peru, is "the most impressive stonework in all of the ancient world," according to a researcher named Luke Caverns. He says it on the show as someone who has seen it himself, part of his case that ancient building was more advanced than we usually think.
